In spring of 2026, I was asked to organise an [ARG](https://en.wikipedia.org/Alternate_reality_game) during [Fallout](https://fallout.hackclub.com). I took on logistics and storyline development and coordinated a team of around four other people. Sadly, I couldn't go to the event myself, but I remember vividly staying up until 2 a.m. the day before to ensure it was actually going to happen. And oh my, looking back at the video it was so worth it!

I could go on for a while, but as you may know, a video is worth more than a thousand words, so I definitely recommend to [go see it for yourself!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=367uw-bGwrE)

Also, do check out [the GitHub organisation](https://github.com/The-Niming-De-Organization/site). Unfortunately, the website for the ARG has been taken offline.
